about_the_game:
ATTENTION: This is a companion app meant to be used following the official TTRPG rules for Astracordis that you can find on our site.

Astracordis is a science fiction tabletop role-playing game focused on space exploration, investigation, diplomacy, and science. It’s played using an app that includes various tools, such as character sheets and a virtual board.

Although combat exists (both on foot and aboard starships), Astracordis is designed for adventures where action is usually the last resort when everything else fails. That’s why our rules include multiple ways to handle non-violent situations, and encourage characters to have a wide range of technical skills. Become a communications officer skilled at analyzing signals, a doctor specialized in exobiology, a captain capable of motivating the crew even in the worst situations, or a hacker specialized in data theft.

Astracordis Access Terminal is the official app for the game, where you'll find all the tools you need to play and run your sessions.

  • Character creator: A virtual assistant that guides you through the character creation process.

  • Character sheet: All the information you need to manage your character (health status, level, skills, and inventory).

  • Virtual dice: Roll dice using a virtual assistant that helps you manage your skills and bonuses.

  • Operations: Operations are groups of complex rolls used to resolve different scenarios. Each type of operation has its own interface.

  • Journal: Take notes during the game or expand on your character with a biography and additional details.

  • Virtual boards: Astracordis Access Terminal includes two virtual boards—one for ground combat and another for space combat. Each has unique features and tools for the Game Master to customize the scenarios.

  • Online Room: Astracordis supports up to six players and one Game Master. The app offers online support and shortcuts so everyone can quickly access each other’s information.

  • GM tools: The Game Master has access to specific tools, such as a file to create boards, unique characters and items, a music player with the Original Astracordis Soundtrack, and a menu to hide dice rolls or send images to players.
